theory.title: Have y get causativos en situaciones de consumo
theory.explanation: Usa have/get + objeto + participio cuando organizas que otra persona te preste un servicio: I had my laptop repaired (mandé reparar mi portátil). Get es más informal. La persona que realiza el trabajo no es el sujeto de la oración.
theory.tip: Have/get + objeto + participio: organizas que otra persona haga el trabajo.

content.passage: When a laptop stopped working, Daniel took it to a repair shop. He had the screen replaced and got the keyboard cleaned. He also had the software updated because it was very slow. His sister was getting her phone repaired at the same shop. They were pleased with the service because the technician explained the costs before starting the work.

items.prompt: Describe a product you have had repaired.
items.modelAnswer: When I buy something, I usually compare prices and read the conditions carefully. If there is a problem, I contact customer service and explain what has happened. I think a good company should listen to customers and offer a fair solution. I keep receipts and confirmation emails in case I need them later. Planning purchases helps me manage my budget and avoid unnecessary expenses.

content.audioTranscript: A: I'm calling about my order. B: Do you have the receipt? A: Yes. The customer service told me I could get a refund. B: Was there a problem with the delivery? A: Yes, so I asked to speak to the manager. B: I'll contact the supplier and check the payment. A: Thank you. Is the parcel going to the right address? B: Yes, it should arrive tomorrow.
